items.quote: After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
items.claim: Sarah questions whether she can experience pleasure and conceive after reaching old age.

items.quote: At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
items.claim: At a divinely appointed time, according to natural cycles of life, Sarah shall bear a son.
items.mechanism: the time appointed; the time of life
